title: Wick Liquor Blue Moon 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Blue Moon by Wick Liquor combines juicy Blueberry with the sharp brightness of Raspberry, lifted by a streak of menthol ice. The cool undertone gives the fruit flavours extra clarity, creating a blend that tastes both sweet and refreshing. Each Shortfill bottle contains 100ml of e-liquid in a 120ml container, leaving space for two 10ml nicotine shots. Adding two 18mg shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. Blended at 70VG/30PG, this liquid is best suited to sub-ohm tanks and high-powered kits, delivering dense vapour and bold, rounded flavour. Wick Liquor, produced in the UK, has earned a reputation for distinctive, high-quality blends. Blue Moon fits seamlessly into their line-up, offering a fruit-and-ice vape with a clear, memorable character.
